Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: Reported and implicitly relied on DuckDuckGo’s auto-generated “Search Assist” snippet stating Edmond T. Gréville died in Paris without immediately verifying it on authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia infobox, IMDb). This introduced incorrect information (the correct place is Nice) and led to confusion, while subsequent attempts failed to extract the infobox details to resolve the discrepancy.
